title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
description:
**Description**
Are you ready to be at the forefront of Agentic AI innovation and redefine the future of communication?
  
  
Join our dynamic Alexa Connections team as an SDE, and lead futuristic agentic AI initiatives that will shape the next generation of intelligent, conversational experiences. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of disruptive AI technologies and real-world impact, making a difference for millions of customers. You'll collaborate with a team of passionate professionals who are as excited about innovation as you are, and together, you'll push the boundaries of what's possible with Alexa+.
  
  
As an SDE, you'll drive the development and scaling of real-time Agentic AI solutions that power our next-generation communication features. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, sciences, design, and engineering, to design and deliver innovative solutions that leverage these AI technologies to enable seamless, intelligent communication experiences. You'll also lead the design and architecture aspects of these advanced AI systems into Alexa's core experience and ensure a high quality bar and CX for our customers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As part of our team, you will design and develop large-scale agentic AI systems that power Communications features on Alexa.
  
  
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand a range of Agentic AI requirements and deliver solutions that ensure high data quality and availability. You will also contribute to evaluating and implementing new technologies to improve our Alexa systems and support team members through knowledge sharing and technical guidance.
  
  
Experience with full-stack development, distributed systems, agentic AI and machine learning will be valuable as you work across various layers of our technology stack to ensure end-to-end data excellence.
  
  
**About The Team**
Alexa Connections aspires to make Alexa+ the world’s most trusted connection assistant for getting things done and creating moments of joy. Our vision emphasizes a) Trust as our foundation for becoming a daily habit, knowing our customers have plentiful choices, b) Completion of end-to-end customer journeys, beyond shipping features, and c) Joy through personalized, proactive experiences, that create a memory.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Maintain model documentation (model cards, data provenance) to support AI governance and regulatory defensibility.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. * Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

title: On-Premises Deployment Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an On-Premises Implementation Engineer with hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. You will install, configure, upgrade and hand over our product on customer-owned servers, including restricted and air-gapped environments, within agreed timelines. This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will assess client infrastructure readiness, deploy the product using Docker and Docker Compose, integrate it with the client’s network, security and identity controls, and support the environment after go-live until it is stable and formally handed over.

**What you will do**

* Review customer infrastructure against product prerequisites: server sizing, OS version, storage, ports, DNS, certificates and firewall rules
* Prepare checklists, deployment plans and implementation schedules for customer IT teams
* Validate server readiness before deployment, including patch level, disk layout, time sync and proxy connectivity
* Install, configure and harden Linux servers (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux)
* Manage users, sudo access, SSH keys, permissions, systemd services, cron jobs and log rotation
* Configure LVM, filesystems, NFS shares and storage for application data and backups
* Configure networking, firewalld/iptables and SELinux/AppArmor in line with customer security standards
* Install Docker Engine and Docker Compose on customer servers, including offline installation
* Deploy, configure and upgrade the product stack using Compose files, environment files and scripts
* Set up local image registries and move images into air-gapped environments using docker save/load or registry mirroring
* Configure Docker networking, volumes, restart policies, resource limits and log drivers
* Troubleshoot container start-up failures, image pull issues, port conflicts, storage and permission errors and inter-service connectivity
* Configure reverse proxies and load balancers (Nginx, HAProxy, Apache) and install SSL/TLS certificates from customer CAs
* Integrate the product with customer databases, SMTP, LDAP/Active Directory and SSO providers such as Keycloak
* Set up and verify PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis when hosted alongside the product
* Plan and run upgrades and patch releases with documented rollback steps and minimal downtime
* Configure backup and restore for application data, databases and Docker volumes, and test restores periodically
* Provide L2 support for deployed environments, including root cause analysis and resolution within SLAs
* Escalate and close product defects with internal development and product teams
* Write installation guides, as-built documents, runbooks and handover notes for each customer
* Run handover and knowledge-transfer sessions for customer IT and operations teams
* Keep an accurate record of each customer’s deployed version, configuration and change history

**What you bring**

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and Docker-based deployment, ideally in product implementation or customer-facing roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent practical experience
* Linux (must have): strong command line skills on RHEL, Rocky or Ubuntu, including dnf/yum, apt, systemd, permissions, LVM, networking, firewalld/iptables, SELinux and log analysis
* Docker (must have): Docker Engine and Compose in production, image management, volumes, networks, private registries, offline image transfer and container troubleshooting
* Web and proxy services: Nginx, HAProxy or Apache, plus SSL/TLS installation and troubleshooting
* Scripting: Bash for installation and operational automation. Python is an advantage
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls, proxies and basic troubleshooting (curl, telnet/nc, tcpdump, ss/netstat)
* Databases: working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or Redis, including install, connectivity, backup and restore
* Support: ticket-based support, root cause analysis and SLA-driven resolution

**Good to have**

* RHCSA, RHCE or LFCS; Docker Certified Associate
* Experience deploying into air-gapped or highly restricted customer networks
* Ansible for repeatable server preparation and deployment
* Monitoring exposure: Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix or Loki
* Keycloak, LDAP/Active Directory or SSO configuration
* Familiarity with CIS Benchmarks for Linux and Docker

**How you work**

* Clear, professional communication with customer IT teams, including non-technical stakeholders
* Structured troubleshooting under time pressure during go-live windows
* Ownership of each implementation from readiness through handover
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and support deployments outside business hours when required

As a Sharepoint Admin, you'll be joining a dynamic team that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Our culture is built on a foundation of integrity and a dedication to the wellbeing of our employees. We celebrate individual differences and foster an environment where everyone can flourish. This role is integral to our IT department, ensuring flawless execution and improvement of our Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
  
  
What You'll Do

* Coordinate the Microsoft Power Platform tenant, including environments, DLP policies, and Managed Environments configuration.
* Establish and uphold governance for Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio agents.
* Develop and maintain Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows, and Copilot agents, ensuring their implementation across different environments.
* Manage Dataverse environments, security roles, and application lifecycle management using pipelines and solution-based deployments.
* Monitor Power Platform usage and drive cost optimization and rationalization initiatives.
* Support and enable citizen developers through standards, templates, training, and the Centre of Excellence toolkit.
* Build, develop, and maintain Power BI datasets, dataflows, semantic models, and reports.
* Coordinate Power BI workspaces, capacities, gateways, and row-level security.
* Implement governance, sensitivity labels, and sharing controls for Power BI content.
* Optimize data models and DAX measures for performance and scalability.
* Coordinate SharePoint Online site collections, permissions, storage, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Support SharePoint and OneDrive migration and content restructuring activities.
* Implement and maintain policies for governance, retention, data loss prevention, external sharing, and access control.
* Support Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI readiness through improving content management and safeguarding access to enterprise content.

* Extensive practical experience in Power Platform administration, including DLP policies and Managed Environments.
* Proven Power Apps and Power Automate development experience, including Dataverse and standard/premium connectors.
* Hands-on Power BI experience covering data modeling, DAX, Power Query, workspace administration, and capacity management.
* Good knowledge of SharePoint Online administration, site management, permissions, and governance.
* Practical experience with Microsoft 365 services, such as Teams, Exchange Online, and Entra ID.

* Understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot preparedness and AI integration principles.
* Solid problem-solving and customer management skills.
* 4+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration and development, specifically focusing on Power Platform and Power BI.
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA or equivalent qualification.

**The Opportunity:**
In our data‑driven organization, we rely on accurate, timely, and high‑quality process insights to improve operational performance and enable informed decision‑making. As a Celonis Coe Domain Lead, you will play a key role in enabling these insights by designing and maintaining robust data pipelines, modeling process data, and integrating information from core business systems into the Celonis platform. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams—including IT, Process Excellence, Operations, and Value Engineers—to ensure that Celonis serves as a trusted analytical foundation for continuous improvement. In this role, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end technical enablement of process intelligence use cases, from data ingestion to transformation, validation, and ongoing performance optimization
**.**
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and maintain reliable ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from ERP, CRM, and other enterprise systems into Celonis, ensuring stability, accuracy, and scalability.
* Data Modeling: Develop optimized data models within Celonis to reflect end‑to‑end business processes, enabling advanced process mining, root‑cause analysis, and automation opportunities.
* Integration Ownership: Collaborate with IT and application owners to integrate data from SAP, Oracle, databases, and other platforms into Celonis, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow aligned with architectural standards.
* Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and improve the performance of Celonis data models and pipelines, addressing bottlenecks and implementing best practices to support long‑term scalability.
* Data Quality Management: Establish and maintain data validation and cleansing mechanisms to ensure high‑quality, trustworthy data for process mining and analytics.
* Collaboration & Enablement: Partner with business analysts, value engineers, and process owners to understand process requirements, translate them into data models, and provide technical guidance for building value‑driven use cases.
* Documentation & Transparency: Create and maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, transformation logic, and Celonis data models to ensure clarity, maintainability, and alignment with internal governance standards.
* Continuous Innovation: Stay current with advancements in Celonis EMS, data engineering practices, and process intelligence technologies, proactively identifying improvement opportunities and contributing to building a scalable data foundation for the organization.
* Operational Excellence: Support the development of dashboards, action flows, and automations within Celonis to drive measurable business outcomes.

* Experience working with large‑scale ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle; strong domain knowledge in at least one SAP module is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with major relational database systems.
* Hands‑on experience with scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript for automation and data transformation.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing, ETL tools, and enterprise data flows.
* Familiarity with cloud environments and data orchestration concepts is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail in data validation and troubleshooting.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver high‑quality outputs in a fast‑paced environment.
* Passion for process improvement, data integrity, and high‑quality analytics.
